The source Ch 010 explains: Tommy had trailed two men, and Tuppence's reasoning had been justified by events — the two men had come from the second floor flat. This framing bridge was cut. The draft's opening sentence simply states "When Tommy set off after the two men" with no prior draft establishment of who these men are or what Tommy's trailing mission was. The Ch 009 draft ends only with Tommy being knocked out; there is no transition establishing that he recovered, regained consciousness, exited the house, returned to Tuppence, and then set off trailing men. A reader with no source access would be genuinely confused: the last they knew, Tommy was unconscious from a blow to the head — now he is apparently recovered and tailing people, with no explanation of how or when.
